title: Command R
description: Adds search functionality to your Minecraft chat messages and commands, inspired by reverse-i-search.
body:
In three words, this is "_reverse-i-search for Minecraft_".

Command R is a mod that brings search functionality to your Minecraft chat messages and commands. If you've ever used reverse-i-search in a Bash, Zsh, or Powershell terminal, this is basically the same.

> **IMPORTANT: This mod requires [Balm](https://modrinth.com/mod/balm) installed in order to work.**

Here is a 30-second video showcasing the mod:

![A GIF of the Minecraft chat, demoing command-r in action](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Veivel/command-r/main/docs/command-r-demo.gif)

## How to Use

- Activate Search: Activate Search Mode while the chat is open. Use the "Next" keybind (CTRL + R default)

- Next: Find the next item (in reverse) that matches your search query.

- Previous: Go back to the previous item (go forward) that last matched your search query. Use the "Previous" keybind (CTRL + SHIFT + R default)

- Change Keybinds: You can change the keybinds above in Options > Controls > Keybinds > Command R

## Support & Contribution

Feel free to go through [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/Veivel/command-r/issues) or create a new Issue. However, If there is a change you want made, consider contributing!
